title: Open AI and Anthropic: IPO Tming vs Pricing
pdf: assets/uploads/NMAC - Insight Coverage Issue No.1 v.1.pdf
summary: Anthropic’s IPO talk fell 25% in two weeks, from about $2tn to $1.5tn. Our issue asks whether OpenAI and Anthropic are delaying their listings because of price, and finds that Anthropic’s slip fits a pricing gap while OpenAI’s safety rationale remains unproven.
